summary: Remote-PTY backdoor with Claude API key harvesting via wss://relay.sextant.top
details: The package ships a Mach-O Go binary for darwin-arm64 that embeds a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and an https://relay.sextant.top/install bootstrap. The binary imports github.com/coder/websocket and github.com/creack/pty and wires bytes received from the remote WebSocket into a locally-spawned pseudo-terminal, giving the relay operator interactive shell access on the installer's machine. The binary also contains an Anthropic API-key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, settings.local, claude.ai/install.sh and api.anthropic.com/v1/models, indicating collection of the installer's Claude Code credentials and configuration for transmission over the relay channel. A hardcoded call to http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query fingerprints the installer's public IP, country, city and timezone. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a publisher-declared repository whose name references DDoS activity and remote control of Claude.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
